title_jp: ゴミ{出し|だし}、お{願い|ねがい}！
context: Tuesday evening, 17 November. {颯太|そうた} has caught the cold going round, so {恵子|けいこ}さん stays the night in {長野|ながの} to look after him, and asks アルちゃん on LINE to deal with tomorrow's rubbish. Today: asking for and doing things in advance.
scene: {恵子|けいこ}さん is away tonight and tomorrow is rubbish day. She asks you on LINE to sort it, and you ask how.

phrases.jp: {分別|ぶんべつ|sorting (rubbish)|3}の{仕方|しかた}、{教えて|おしえて}もらえますか？
phrases.en: Could you show me how to sort the rubbish?
phrases.note: To a neighbour or the town office. With family, drop to {教|おし}えてもらえる？

phrases.jp: {出かける|でかける}{前|まえ}に、{窓|まど}を{閉めといて|しめといて}くれる？
phrases.en: Could you shut the windows before you go out?
phrases.note: 〜といてくれる？ = do it now so it's done later. Very common at home.

phrases.jp: {燃える|もえる|to burn|3}ゴミは{何曜日|なんようび}ですか？
phrases.note: The first question in any new town: every town has its own rubbish calendar.

phrases.jp: すみません、ゴミの{出し方|だしかた}、{間違って|まちがって}いましたか？
phrases.en: Sorry, did I put the rubbish out wrong?
phrases.note: For a neighbour pointing at your bag. Apologise first; it calms things down.

phrases.jp: {悪い|わるい}けど、ちょっと{頼んで|たのんで}もいい？
phrases.en: Sorry, can I ask you a favour?
phrases.note: 悪いけど softens a request to friends or family. Politely: {申し訳|もうしわけ}ないんですが…

dialogue_setting: The {田中|たなか} family LINE group, Tuesday evening: {恵子|けいこ}さん is with a feverish {颯太|そうた} in {長野市|ながのし}; アルちゃん is in the {田中|たなか} kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: {颯太|そうた}が{熱|ねつ}を{出した|だした}の。{薬|くすり|medicine|4}を{買って|かって}、{今夜|こんや}は{長野|ながの}で{看病|かんびょう|looking after a sick person|2}するね
dialogue.en: {颯太|そうた} has a fever. I'll buy medicine and look after him in {長野|ながの} tonight.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: え、{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}？{例の|れいの|that (one we know about)|3}{風邪|かぜ}かな…お{大事|だいじ|take care (to the sick)|4}にって{伝えて|つたえて|to pass on (a message)|4}！
dialogue.en: Oh no, is he OK? That cold going round?… Tell him to get well soon!

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: それでお{願い|ねがい}！{明日|あした}は{燃える|もえる|to burn|3}ゴミの{日|ひ}なんだけど、お{父さん|とうさん}{忘れっぽい|わすれっぽい|forgetful|3}から…
dialogue.en: So, a favour! Tomorrow is burnable-rubbish day, but Dad is so forgetful…

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: {今夜|こんや}のうちに{分別|ぶんべつ|sorting (rubbish)|3}しといてくれる？{朝|あさ}8{時|じ}までに{出して|だして}ね
dialogue.en: Could you sort it tonight? Put it out by 8 in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {任せて|まかせて|leave it to (me)|3}！でも{分別|ぶんべつ|sorting (rubbish)|3}の{仕方|しかた}、{教えて|おしえて}もらえる？
dialogue.en: Leave it to me! But could you tell me how to sort it?

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: {生ゴミ|なまごみ|kitchen scraps|3}と{紙|かみ}は{黄色い|きいろい}{袋|ふくろ}へ。{袋|ふくろ}に{名前|なまえ}も{書いて|かいて}ね
dialogue.en: Food scraps and paper go in the yellow bag. Write our name on the bag too.

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: {缶|かん|can, tin|3}と{瓶|びん|bottle, jar|3}は{金曜|きんよう}。{洗って|あらって}、{缶|かん|can, tin|3}は{潰して|つぶして|to crush, squash|3}おいてね
dialogue.en: Cans and bottles are Friday. Rinse them, and crush the cans and keep them aside.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {了解|りょうかい|got it|4}！ゴミ{置き場|おきば|spot, place for (something)|3}は、バス{停|てい}の{横|よこ}だよね？
dialogue.en: Got it! The rubbish collection point is next to the bus stop, right?

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: そう！あ、じゃがいもは{納屋|なや|barn, shed|2}に{用意|ようい|preparation|4}しといたからね。{土曜日|どようび}、{頑張って|がんばって}！
dialogue.en: Yes! Oh, and I've put the potatoes ready in the shed. Good luck on Saturday!

listening.intro: Later, as you carry the bag out, the town loudspeakers come on.
listening.title: {役場|やくば}からのお{知らせ|しらせ}
listening.place: {鷹ノ原町|たかのはらまち}, town loudspeakers

lines.jp: こちらは{鷹ノ原町|たかのはらまち}{役場|やくば|town office|2}です。{粗大ゴミ|そだいごみ|large rubbish (furniture etc.)|2}の{回収|かいしゅう|collection|2}のお{知らせ|しらせ}です。
lines.en: This is the {鷹ノ原町|たかのはらまち} town office, with news about large-item rubbish collection.

lines.jp: {回収|かいしゅう|collection|2}は28{日|にち}の{土曜日|どようび}です。25{日|にち}までに、{役場|やくば|town office|2}に{電話|でんわ}で{申し込んで|もうしこんで|to apply|3}ください。
lines.en: Collection is on Saturday the 28th. Apply by phone to the town office by the 25th.

listening.question: {粗大|そだい}ゴミを{出|だ}したい{人|ひと}は、いつまでに{電話|でんわ}しますか。
listening.explain: 25{日|にち}までに{申|もう}し{込|こ}んで: phone by the 25th. The 28th is the collection day itself.

grammar.meaning: do in advance, leave as is
grammar.form: {動詞|どうし}て{形|けい}: + おく ({書|か}いておく, {潰|つぶ}しておく) · casual: 〜ておく → 〜とく ({置|お}いとく, {用意|ようい}しといた) · casual: 〜でおく → 〜どく ({読|よ}んどく, {飲|の}んどく)
grammar.explanation: Do something now so it's ready later, or leave things as they are. In speech ておく shrinks to とく/どく: {閉|し}めといて = {閉|し}めておいて. Don't confuse it with てある, which describes a state someone left, not your action.

examples.jp: {旅行|りょこう}の{前|まえ}に、{切符|きっぷ|ticket|4}を{買っておきます|かっておきます}。
examples.en: I'll buy the tickets before the trip.

examples.jp: {暑い|あつい}から、{窓|まど}は{開けといて|あけといて}。
examples.en: It's hot, so leave the window open.

examples.jp: {会議|かいぎ|meeting|4}の{資料|しりょう|documents, materials|3}、{今日|きょう}{読んどく|よんどく}ね。
examples.en: I'll read the meeting papers today, ahead of time.

quiz.question: {明日|あした}は{早い|はやい}から、{今夜|こんや}{荷物|にもつ}を{準備|じゅんび|preparation|4}して＿＿。
quiz.en: I'm up early tomorrow, so I'll get my bag ready tonight.
quiz.explain: Getting ready now for tomorrow = ておく: {準備|じゅんび}しておこう. てみよう would be 'let's try'.

quiz_more.question: ビール、{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}に{入れ|いれ}＿＿よ。
quiz_more.en: I've put the beer in the fridge (ready for later).
quiz_more.explain: といた = ておいた, done in advance. ちゃった would sound like 'oops, I put it in'.

quiz_more.question: その{本|ほん}、{先|さき}に{読ん|よん}＿＿ね。
quiz_more.explain: {読|よ}む's て-form is {読|よ}んで, so でおいて shrinks to どいて, not といて.

kanji.where: On the town rubbish calendar stuck to the {田中|たなか} fridge, and printed on the yellow designated bags.
kanji.breakdown: {可燃|かねん}: 可 can, possible + 燃 burn → 'burnable'. Signs say {可燃|かねん}ごみ; people say {燃|も}えるゴミ.
kanji.related: {不燃|ふねん}ごみ = non-burnable rubbish (不 = not).

tip.title: Never the night before
tip.body: Rubbish goes out on the morning of collection, usually by 8, not the night before: crows and cats tear bags open. A wrongly sorted bag gets a warning sticker and is left behind for you to fix. Some country towns ask you to write your name on the bag.

challenge.prompt: {健太|けんた}: 「アルちゃん、じゃがいもどうなった？」 Tell him {恵子|けいこ}さん has got them ready, and ask him to buy his own {材料|ざいりょう|ingredients|3} in advance.
challenge.model_answer: {恵子|けいこ}さんが{用意|ようい}しといてくれたよ！{健太|けんた}も{材料|ざいりょう|ingredients|3}、{買っといて|かっといて}ね。
challenge.explanation: {用意|ようい}しといてくれた = she prepared them in advance for you: とく + くれる shows the favour. {買|か}っといてね is the casual request, right for a friend like {健太|けんた}.

vocab.note: {看|かん} watch over + {病|びょう} illness. {看病|かんびょう}する: family nursing at home.
{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}む = take medicine (even pills: 飲む, not {食|た}べる).
{燃|も}えるゴミ = burnable rubbish. Transitive: {燃|も}やす (to burn something).
〜っぽい = tends to: {怒|おこ}りっぽい (quick-tempered).
ゴミの{分別|ぶんべつ}. Read ふんべつ it means 'good sense': a different word.
{缶|かん}ビール, {缶|かん}コーヒー. Recycled separately from bottles.
Often written びん. Plastic bottles are ペットボトル.
Also {時間|じかん}を{潰|つぶ}す = kill time.
{置|お}く put + {場|ば} place. ゴミ{置|お}き{場|ば}, {自転車|じてんしゃ}{置|お}き{場|ば}.
{用意|ようい}する: get things ready. Close to {準備|じゅんび}, more everyday.

kanji_study.parts: 火 fire radical + 然, which has 灬 (fire again) at the bottom → fire on two sides: burn.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 然 (so, nature): 燃 adds 火 on the left.

kanji_study.parts: 艹 grass radical + 楽 (ease, comfort) → plants that make you feel better: medicine.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 楽 (fun, ease): 薬 has 艹 grass on top.

extras.intro: The words on every town's rubbish calendar.

items.note: Food scraps, paper, small plastics in many towns.

items.jp: {燃えない|もえない|to burn|3}ゴミ

items.note: Remove the cap and label first.
Book a collection; usually you pay with a sticker.

extras.title_jp: {頼み方|たのみかた}いろいろ

ちょっと{見て|みて}ほしいんだけど…
items.en: I'd like you to take a look…

items.jp: {教えて|おしえて}いただけますか？
お{手数|てすう|trouble, bother|2}ですが、よろしくお{願い|ねがい}します
items.en: Sorry for the trouble; thank you in advance.
